label: Wrong denominator
observable_evidence: Uses the new value rather than the original value as the percentage-change base
non_evidence: Single arithmetic slip without repeated denominator choice
approved_feedback: Ask which quantity represents the starting amount and why

label: Sign error during rearrangement
observable_evidence: Changes sides but does not apply the inverse operation consistently
approved_feedback: Ask the student to apply the same operation to both sides

label: Simple and compound interest confused
observable_evidence: Uses simple-interest addition where repeated compounding is required or conversely
approved_feedback: Ask whether interest is added to the base before the next period

label: Nominal and periodic rate confused
observable_evidence: Uses an annual stated rate as the per-period rate
non_evidence: Correct use where the period is one year
approved_feedback: Ask how many compounding periods occur in one year

label: Rule selection error
observable_evidence: Applies a derivative rule that does not match the expression structure
non_evidence: Arithmetic error after the correct derivative rule
approved_feedback: Ask the student to identify the outer operation and relevant rule

label: Mean and median confused
observable_evidence: Describes or calculates one measure while naming the other
approved_feedback: Ask what the measure uses and how extreme values affect it

label: Population and sample divisor confused
observable_evidence: Uses n where n minus one is required or conversely without justification
non_evidence: A course convention explicitly permitting the chosen form
approved_feedback: Ask whether the data represent the full population or a sample

label: Addition and multiplication confused
observable_evidence: Adds probabilities for a joint event or multiplies for an alternative event without conditions
non_evidence: A valid use under independence or disjointness
approved_feedback: Ask whether the question means and or or and what dependence exists

label: Complement omitted
observable_evidence: Directly sums many cases when a complement is required or misses the complement step
approved_feedback: Ask whether calculating the opposite event would be simpler

label: Z-score direction reversed
observable_evidence: Subtracts observation from mean when the defined convention is observation minus mean
approved_feedback: Ask what a positive z-score should mean for an above-average observation

label: Null and alternative confused
observable_evidence: States the research claim as the null without testing convention or reverses decision wording
approved_feedback: Ask which claim is tested for evidence against it

label: Correlation treated as causation
observable_evidence: Claims the association alone proves a causal effect
non_evidence: A causal design with stated assumptions
approved_feedback: Ask what alternative explanations the observed association leaves open

label: Slope and intercept misinterpreted
observable_evidence: Interprets slope as the outcome at zero or intercept as per-unit change
non_evidence: Correct calculation with imprecise language only
approved_feedback: Ask what changes when the predictor increases by one unit
